desc: Establish SDF contents (read-only): confirm exactly which geometry is voxelized — SetTile fires tileCallback (yes), SetGlobal/SetLandmarks via enqueueGlobal (no), player/terrain (no) — and run ./scripts/run.sh play log 5000, pull 'GI context created' + 'brixelizer: ... bricksInUse=... instances=... tiles=...' lines from build/c-game/data/game.log. Deliverable: one-line statement of what's in the SDF with log excerpt as evidence. Also confirm whether the house under test is a settlement building (SetGlobal) or a per-tile prop.
result: SDF contains ONLY per-tile vegetation props (22,471 instances, 1 tile, 9,276 resident bricks, stable). House is a settlement building in SetGlobal slot — NOT voxelized. GI context alive at 2880x1627.

desc: Establish GI aliveness + raw output (read-only): run ENGINE_BRIX_GI_SAVE=1 ENGINE_BRIX_GI_SAVE_EVERY=1 ./scripts/run.sh play log 5000, confirm GI dispatch ran, inspect /tmp/brix_gi_diffuse_*.jpg and _specular_ for non-zero content. Deliverable: whether raw GI has content, its rough scale, and failure signature (all-black = not alive; per-frame noise = reprojection/disocclusion bug).
result: Raw diffuse GI alive: 98-99% pixels non-zero, colorful (B>G>R, sky+veg bounce), stable after warmup (settled meanDiff 3.5/255). Specular GI structurally zero (SDF has only vegetation). Not a dead-pipeline bug.

desc: Composite A/B (read-only): at unchanged parked vantage capture ./scripts/run.sh play screenshot /tmp/gi_on.jpg (default) and same with ENGINE_BRIX_GI_DIFFUSE_FACTOR=0 ENGINE_BRIX_GI_SPECULAR_FACTOR=0 to /tmp/gi_off.jpg, and diff them. Deliverable: whether composite output actually changes when GI is disabled (proves/disproves consumption) and a magnitude estimate of the GI contribution. Do not move the parked player/camera.
result: Composite DOES consume GI: zeroing factors darkens whole frame (mean +9.0/255, 92.6% px brighter with GI). House wall +10.9, player +9.0, grass +10.5. Lift is near-uniform hue (sky+veg ambient), not directional color-bleed. Pipeline end-to-end healthy.

desc: Branch decision: based on tasks 1-3, state the verdict — 'expected by design (SDF-only-vegetation), lift working but subtle (envIntensity 0.1)' vs 'real defect at stage X (SDF empty / GI zero / reprojection noise / composite not consuming)' — and if defect, pick the next single targeted fix. Do NOT start the feed-buildings/terrain-into-voxelizer change (approach C) without explicit go-ahead.
result: VERDICT: not a defect. Ambient GI (sky x0.1 + veg bounce) IS consumed and lifts player/house/terrain ~+10/255 (subtle by design). True inter-surface color bleed CANNOT work: only vegetation is in the SDF. Options: raise ENGINE_BRIX_GI_DIFFUSE_FACTOR / BRIX_GI_ENV_INTENSITY (cosmetic) or Approach C (voxelize buildings/terrain — new workstream, needs user go-ahead).

desc: If a real defect is found (per task 4), fix it so diffuse GI works as designed; rebuild with ./scripts/build.sh.
result: No defect found (task 4 verdict) — nothing to fix.
